dialogues.speaker: Vindia
dialogues.text: Oh, my dear, it would be best not to disturb him. Mr. Bickerstaff has quite the temper. Writers who wrestle with satire but can't quite finish the novel often end up like that.

dialogues.speaker: Vindia
dialogues.text: Her Majesty the High King {RUBY#[D]Errighenth} of Aremorica has more than a few such fellows in her service as well. In a sense, I suppose you could call it a kind of knightly spirit.
